text: The skill treats `.outcomegraph/events/dogfood-status.json` as the canonical acceptance artifact, preserves `.outcomegraph/events/dogfood-status-pre-sync.json` as the pre-sync baseline, expects the pre-sync snapshot to be `warn` on a fresh bootstrap, and documents that the run leaves generated output under `.outcomegraph/` and `skills/outcome-steward/`.
